plugin.note: Use melee for unstable ice; exploit crush weakness and negative flat armour. Scythe, ordinary crush and complete Blood Moon sets are separate preparations.

requirements: The Heart of Darkness is required for repeatable encounters.
Recommended combat levels are 60 Attack/Strength/Defence/Hitpoints;37 Prayer enables Protect from Magic.
mechanics: Amoxliatl has negative 2 flat armour and low crush defence.
Fire spells have a 30% weakness bonus, but unstable ice can only be damaged with melee.
Protect from Magic covers the initial magical hit but not the typeless ice-spike damage or lingering icy pools.
Leave the targeted tile during ordinary attacks; pools deal 6-10 damage per tick and reduce safe floor space.
Destroy unstable ice with melee before 15 ticks elapse. Surviving blocks create 3 x3 pools and heal Amoxliatl 16-25 each.
Attacks on unstable ice deal a guaranteed maximum hit and have a 1 tick attack delay; food eaten after destroying a block does not impose the usual attack delay.
Icicle Crash disables active prayers before its attack; Protect from Magic negates that attack when reactivated.
The first special is random; later specials alternate after 2-4 ordinary attacks unless the narrow approach prevents Unstable Ice.
Leave the chamber between kills for optional moonlight-moth prayer restoration.

A scythe swing may hit Amoxliatl and unstable ice together; the block's faster attack cycle can increase damage.

methods.label: Narrow approach technique
methods.summary: The three-tile-wide approach prevents Unstable Ice, so Amoxliatl uses Icicle Crash for every special.
steps: This can save time destroying blocks but leaves less room to avoid ice spikes and pools. It is an optional technique for any of the melee preparations.

methods.label: Transport and permanent shortcut
methods.summary: Use the Twilight Temple statue or a quetzal route, then the unlocked Tower of Ascension shortcut.
steps: A Pendant of Ates must be charged and its Twilight Temple statue activated.
Build the Salvager Overlook landing site and travel south-east, or travel to Quetzacalli Gorge and pass the large gate.
After The Heart of Darkness, take the lift from the mural/statue chamber to permanently unlock the Tower of Ascension shortcut.

methods.label: Optional thralls and Death Charge
methods.summary: Melee remains the damage baseline; Arceuus support spells are optional.
steps: Prepare the Arceuus spellbook, Book of the Dead and the level/runes for the selected resurrection spell.

The Wiki inventory carries fire, blood, cosmic and death runes in a rune pouch, plus soul runes for Death Charge. Quantities depend on the chosen spells and intended trip; they are not included in the baseline rune calculation.

methods.label: Prayer restoration and trip supplies
methods.summary: Moonlight moths outside the chamber can replace some prayer potions at the cost of time.
steps: 75 Hunter with an equipped butterfly net or85 Hunter barehanded permits moonlight-moth restoration.
An ectoplasmator grants Prayer experience per kill; this is not prayer-point restoration.
Carry a special weapon, combat boost, food, emergency teleport and prayer restoration. The displayed quantities are planning defaults, not a complete-assignment estimate.
A Saradomin godsword special on unstable ice has a guaranteed maximum hit for sustain.
